title: ProjectionMetadata
description: Metadata needed to audit a graph projection for ⟨profileId, at, policyId⟩. The `projectionHash` lets analytical artifacts prove compatibility before reuse (see spec/11).

profileVersion.description: Exact version of the profile used. REQUIRED: an id alone may be rebound, and it is ⟨profileId, profileVersion⟩ that resolves to the profile's `vocabularyRef`, hence to the vocabulary version under which the projection's relations are identified.

policyVersion.description: Exact version of the admission policy used. REQUIRED for the same reason as `profileVersion`.

sourceRevision.description: The source substrate revision, when applicable.

projectionHash.description: Stable hash of the admitted edge set for compatibility proofs.
